blocks.html: The results of an inspection required by Sections 3307.6.5.7 through 3307.6.5.10 shall be recorded in an inspection report that is prepared, signed, and dated by the person who performed the inspection. In lieu of compliance with the requirements of Section 3301.7, copies of the inspection reports required by Sections 3307.6.5.7 through 3307.6.5.10 shall be maintained at the site by the general contractor, or where there is no general contractor, the contractor causing the work to be performed, or where there is no active work, by the building owner.
